populations.label: General adult population
populations.ancestry_note: Source cohorts are predominantly of European ancestry and drawn from high-income countries; ancestry is inconsistently reported across the underlying studies.
populations.cohort_note: A composite of the mixed-sex adult cohorts used by the cited sources. It is not a single measured cohort and should not be treated as one.
caveats: Composite of heterogeneous cohorts; values from different sources are not directly poolable.
Predominantly high-income, European-ancestry samples, so generalisation elsewhere is uncertain.
Sex-stratified differences are real for several measures but are not separated in this seed corpus.
Cross-sectional sources cannot distinguish aging from cohort effects.
